selectionObjective: Identify next highest-value experimental dataset for ENG-003, ENG-004, and ENG-005

engineInventory.name: PHEngineV2
engineInventory.missingEvidence: Empirical potentiometric titration curves (pH vs mL titrant) under high electrolyte ionic strength (> 0.2M).

engineInventory.name: SurfactantMicellizationEngine
existingEvidence: EVD-002 / DS-001 (SURFPRO Zenodo 15861809 - Numerically Inspected, pure-component input reference only)
engineInventory.missingEvidence: Binary mixed-surfactant titration series (varying mole fractions) to validate interaction parameter beta and mixed micelle synergy.

engineInventory.name: RheologyViscosityEngine
existingEvidence: EVD-003 (Chitre et al. Shampoo Sci Data 2024 - uninspected)
engineInventory.missingEvidence: Standard rotational shear flow curves (shear stress vs shear rate) on surfactant-thickened detergent solutions.

engineInventory.name: BuilderChelationEngine
engineInventory.missingEvidence: Raw calcium ion-selective electrode (ISE) potentiometric titration curves in presence of citrate/GLDA builders.

engineInventory.name: FoamKineticsEngine
engineInventory.missingEvidence: Dynamic foam height time series, lamellar film drainage thickness, and bubble size distribution under controlled hardness.

engineInventory.name: CostingIntegrityEngine
engineInventory.missingEvidence: None. Engine verified under Phase 1 pricing integrity.

candidateDatasets.name: Household Detergent Foam & Rheology Profiles (Allgood & Jones, Rheol. Acta 2026)

files.name: Supplementary_SolutionFlowCurves.xlsx
files.measurements: Rotational shear rate (0.1 to 100 1/s) vs shear stress (Pa) and apparent viscosity (mPa*s) for detergent solutions

files.name: Supplementary_FilmThickness_v1.xlsx
files.measurements: Inter-bubble fluid film thickness (micrometers) over 20-minute foam drainage period across commercial detergents A-D

files.name: Supplementary_BubbleSizes_v1.xlsx
files.measurements: Bubble diameter distributions (d10, d50, d90, Sauter mean d32 in micrometers)

files.name: Supplementary_RheometerData_v2.xlsx
files.measurements: Foam rheology (storage modulus G', loss modulus G'', yield stress in Pa)

candidateDatasets.rationale: Directly targets the two zero-evidence engines (ENG-005 Foam Kinetics and ENG-003 Rheology). Small downloadable files (< 200 KB per table), verified MD5 checksums, CC-BY-4.0 license, and primary peer-reviewed experimental measurements on commercial household detergents.

candidateDatasets.name: RheoPy / RheoData Wormlike Micelle Flow Curve Series (caggioni_wlm_polymer_temp_series)

files.name: data.csv
files.measurements: Shear rate (0.01 to 100 1/s) vs shear stress (Pa) at 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28 C

candidateDatasets.rationale: High file feasibility, but dataset.yaml explicitly states: 'Paper: Unpublished (community contribution), authors: [], doi: null'. Surfactant chemical formulation details and purity are uncertified, making it unsuitable as an authoritative benchmark.

candidateDatasets.name: Chitre et al. High-Throughput Shampoo Formulation Dataset
authors: Chitre, Querimit, Rihm, Hippalgaonkar, et al.

files.name: shampoo_formulations_dataset.csv
files.measurements: Viscosity at single shear rate (20 1/s), centrifugal stability score

candidateDatasets.rationale: Focuses on personal care conditioning shampoos (silicones, polyquaterniums) rather than household detergent matrix. Only reports single-point shear viscosity rather than full flow curve, limiting validation of Herschel-Bulkley or Carreau-Yasuda models.

candidateDatasets.name: Alvarez-Gomez et al. Surfactant Mesophase Boundary SAXS Dataset

files.name: Supplementary_Data_1.xlsx
files.measurements: Small-angle X-ray scattering intensity vs scattering vector q, phase boundary wt%

candidateDatasets.rationale: Targets ENG-002, which already has SURFPRO numerically inspected. SAXS diffraction data requires complex 2D Bragg peak fitting rather than direct formulation validation, whereas foam and chelation have zero empirical data.

candidateDatasets.name: NIST Critically Selected Stability Constants of Metal Complexes (SRD 46)

files.name: NIST46_Database (Legacy Binary)
files.measurements: Thermodynamic stability constants (log K) for Ca2+/Mg2+ with citrate, NTA, EDTA

candidateDatasets.rationale: Proprietary database distributed as legacy Windows binary; cannot be downloaded or parsed via open REST API in AI Studio container. Supplies thermodynamic constants rather than raw potentiometric electrode titration runs.

selectedNextDataset.name: Household Detergent Foam Profiles & Rheology Benchmark (Zenodo Record 18961871)
requiredDependencies: xlsx (or python openpyxl via script) for parsing tabular sheets
